memory_candidates.content: Reynolds 2001 CTL* completeness consumes its limit-closure axiom only in Lemma 17 (ban preservation) and there needs the UNTIL-form LC; the F-form LC_n (Reynolds 2003, F/P-only language) does not discharge the segment guard. For L-plus with untl/snce primitive the schema of record is LCU plus its mirror.

In the all-walks ZTime semantics, a fresh-atom (state-valued) initialisation of a clock-anchored automaton is sound only through the full-product lemma for (past-type, future-type) at the cut, which presupposes Gabbay separation; separation is consumed at that one point of the completeness architecture.
